en: Galatians 5

p.src: 1  Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

en: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
u.src: 1  Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

p.src: 2  Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

en: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
u.src: 2  Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

p.src: 3  Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

en: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
u.src: 3  Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

p.src: 4  You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

en: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
u.src: 4  You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

p.src: 5  For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

en: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
u.src: 5  For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

p.src: 6  For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
u.src: 6  For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

p.src: 7  You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

en: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
u.src: 7  You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

p.src: 8  This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

en: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
u.src: 8  This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

p.src: 9  A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

en: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
u.src: 9  A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

p.src: 10  I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

en: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
u.src: 10  I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

p.src: 11  But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

en: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
u.src: 11  But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

p.src: 12  I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

en: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
u.src: 12  I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

p.src: 13  For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

en: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
u.src: 13  For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

p.src: 14  For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

en: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
u.src: 14  For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

en: 5:14 Leviticus 19:18

p.src: 15  But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

en: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
u.src: 15  But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

zh: 聖靈的果子和肉體的惡行

p.src: 16  But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

en: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
u.src: 16  But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

p.src: 17  For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

en: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
u.src: 17  For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

p.src: 18  But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

en: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
u.src: 18  But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

p.src: 19  Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

en: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
u.src: 19  Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

p.src: 20  idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

en: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
u.src: 20  idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

p.src: 21  envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

en: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
u.src: 21  envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

p.src: 22  But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
u.src: 22  But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

en: 5:22 or, faithfulness

p.src: 23  gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

en: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
u.src: 23  gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

p.src: 24  Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

en: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
u.src: 24  Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

p.src: 25  If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

en: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
u.src: 25  If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

p.src: 26  Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

en: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
u.src: 26  Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
